summary: @servicetitan/navigation preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall script that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory and then uses execFileSync to invoke Bun against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated loader (rotated string/constant array, rotation function, string-decoder — the shape of an obfuscator.io self-decoding payload) whose content is unrelated to the package's declared purpose (React navigation components). Executing the payload under a fetched Bun binary rather than Node bypasses Node-level sandboxes and inspection. The scope/description (@servicetitan/navigation, navigation components) does not match shipping an install-time alternate-runtime dropper, consistent with a hijacked or trojanized publish of the @servicetitan npm scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
